That id is none of the four LC ids Wikidata holds for him (n79021164 Twain, plus n93099439, n93099461 and no2003079632 for the real-name and pseudonym records). LC's records for Twain and his pseudonyms all seem to be in Wikidata already, so this is likely a cancelled or duplicate LCCN, or a wrong reconciliation in this low-quality LUX record (its own label misspells 'Smauel'). It needs an id.loc.gov lookup before adding or rejecting it; nothing here supports adding it to Wikidata.
